title: Adjournment speech on public transport: bus contracting, rail financing and autonomous vehicles
what_it_is: An adjournment motion moved by the Deputy Leader of the House, followed by an adjournment speech by Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis setting out proposals on buses, rail and autonomous vehicles, and a response from the Senior Minister of State for Transport, Ms Sun Xueling.
why_it_matters: The transcript sets out planned changes to public transport: the rail network is to grow from 275 kilometres today to about 360 kilometres by the early 2030s, and more than half of bus services now run at intervals of 10 minutes or less during peak. Six autonomous buses have been procured and are due to start operating on Bus Services 400 and 191 in the second half of 2026.

key_points.point: The Deputy Leader of the House moved that Parliament adjourn.
key_points.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
key_points.quote: I seek to move, "That Parliament do now adjourn."

key_points.point: Mr Chua said the Land Transport Authority aims for 75% of peak hour journeys by public transport by 2030, and that the figure was 66% in financial year 2024.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: the LTA aims to have 75% of all peak hour journeys carried out via public transport by 2030

key_points.point: Mr Chua said the proportion of local bus captains fell from 54% to 41% between 2021 and 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: From 2021 to 2025, the proportion of local bus captains dropped from 54% to 41%

key_points.point: Mr Chua asked whether bus scheduled headways could be set at 10 minutes or less.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Can we aim for a shorter scheduled headway of 10 minutes or less, period?

key_points.point: Mr Chua cited the Tampines bus package award to Go-Ahead Group at $646 million over an incumbent bid of $596 million.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: the LTA awarded the contract to the Go-Ahead Group, the company that placed the highest bids, for $646 million instead of offering it to the incumbent operator who placed the lowest bid of $596 million

key_points.point: Mr Chua asked the Government to accelerate tendering for the remaining four of 14 bus packages never put up for competitive tender.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: I hope that the Government can accelerate the calling of tenders for the remaining four of 14 bus packages that have never been put up for competitive tender

key_points.point: Mr Chua proposed publishing bus operator performance data annually.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Publishing this annually, as Transport for London does quarterly, would cost nothing additional

key_points.point: Mr Chua called for a renewed rail financing framework converging all lines onto a single service-fee framework and consolidating rail operations under a single publicly owned national rail operator.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: I therefore call for a renewed rail financing framework: to complete the convergence of all rail lines onto a single, unified service-fee framework, and go one step further by consolidating rail operations under a single, publicly owned national rail operator.

key_points.point: Mr Chua said AV roll-out remains largely in the trial phase, with around 20 AVs on short fixed routes in Punggol.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: our AV roll-out remains largely in the trial phase, with only around 20 AVs involved in short, fixed route services in Punggol

key_points.point: Mr Chua said six autonomous buses were procured at $8 million and are due to operate on Bus Services 400 and 191 in the second half of 2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: We also have six autonomous buses procured at a contract value of $8 million, due to start operating on Bus Services 400 and 191 in the second half of 2026.

key_points.point: Mr Chua asked the Ministry of Transport to provide numerical targets for its AV ambition.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: can the MOT provide numerical targets for our AV ambition

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the Government's ambition is 75% peak-period public transport mode share.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Our ambition to achieve 75% peak-period mode share reflects this.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said about $2 billion a year is spent on public transport operating costs.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We invest heavily in our public transport system, about $2 billion a year on public transport operating costs

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the rail network will grow from 275 kilometres today to about 360 kilometres by the early 2030s.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: we are growing the rail network from 275 kilometres today to about 360 kilometres by the early 2030s

key_points.point: Ms Sun said station locations for Phase 3 of the Cross Island Line were announced the previous week, and that travel to and from the West can be cut by up to 50 minutes.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Just last week, we announced the station locations for Phase 3 of the Cross Island Line.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said 11 new City Direct Services have been rolled out under the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme since 2024.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We have rolled out 11 new City Direct Services since we started the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme in 2024

key_points.point: Ms Sun said service fees paid by the Government to bus operators have dropped by 15% since tendering out bus packages.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Since we transited to tendering out bus packages, service fees paid by the Government to the operators have dropped by 15%.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said bus contracts are awarded through a two-envelope process considering quality first, then price.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: The contracts are awarded based on a two-envelope evaluation process that considers first, quality and then, price.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said more than half of bus services now run at intervals of 10 minutes or less during peak, above the 15-minute baseline.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Now, more than half of the bus services run at intervals of 10 minutes or less during peak, exceeding the baseline standard of 15 minutes.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the suggestion to share more bus operator performance data can be considered.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We can consider Mr Chua's suggestion to share more data on bus operators' performance over time.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the Government is working with operators to attract more bus captains by raising starting salaries.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: we are working with operators to attract more bus captains by raising starting salaries

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the Government is working towards an AV Act.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We are also working towards the AV Act, which would cover some of the questions that he has raised.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said there are different rail industry models around the world with their own strengths and trade-offs.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: There are different rail industry models around the world, each with its own strengths and trade-offs.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the New Rail Financing Framework consolidated asset ownership under the Government, enabling a long-term view of asset renewal.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: The NRFF consolidated asset ownership under the Government, which enabled us to take a long-term view of asset renewal

key_points.point: Ms Sun said rail reliability standards are maintained above the one million mean kilometres between failure target.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We have achieved and maintained high rail reliability standards, above our one million mean kilometres between failure target.

key_points.point: Ms Sun said the Rail Reliability Taskforce recommendations are being implemented and more updates will follow.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We are implementing the recommendations of the Taskforce and will provide more updates along the way.

key_points.point: The Speaker informed Members that the sitting the next day would commence at 10.30 am, and Parliament adjourned at 8.15 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: Pursuant to Standing Order 2(3)(a), I wish to inform hon Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 10.30 am.

what_happens_next: The Senior Minister of State said the Rail Reliability Taskforce recommendations are being implemented with more updates to come, and that the Government is working towards an AV Act. The Speaker said the sitting the next day would commence at 10.30 am, and Parliament adjourned at 8.15 pm.
not_said: Whether the 75% peak-period public transport mode share target will be met by 2030
Whether the remaining four bus packages will be put up for competitive tender
Whether bus operator performance data will be published annually
Whether rail operations will be consolidated under a single publicly owned national rail operator
What numerical targets, if any, will be set for autonomous vehicle deployment
When the AV Act will be introduced
